title: While background data transfer to a device is in progress, Reboot/shutdown can be triggered but will be delayed at the TTY
line: The shutdown and restart screens now say how much data is still being written to disk, and that shutting down will wait for it.
explanation: KIO reports a copy as finished once the data is in the page cache; on a slow USB stick the kernel can need minutes more to write it out, and shutting down then waits at the console (udisks' 'stop job') with no warning in Plasma. The logout greeter now reads the pending amount (Dirty + Writeback in /proc/meminfo) every second and exposes it to the logout screen, ignoring amounts under 64 MiB that flush within a moment. The shutdown/restart screen (and the all-options screen) shows an italic hint like the existing 'other users are logged in' one, with the live amount, which disappears once the data has been written.

commits.message:
logout-greeter: expose how much data is still waiting to be written

After a big copy to a slow drive finishes, shutting down can sit at the
console for a long time while the kernel flushes it, with no warning in
Plasma. Read the pending amount and keep it updated for the logout screen.

BUG: 454367

logout: warn when data is still being written to disk

Shutting down or restarting right after copying lots of data to a slow
drive waits at the console until it has all been written. Say how much
is left on the shutdown and restart screens, so you can wait for it.

BUG: 454367

patches.diff:
From 2646a7efc896bc7e1e37d2a78dcc74ace59e0a29 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:58:22 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] logout: warn when data is still being written to disk

Shutting down or restarting right after copying lots of data to a slow
drive waits at the console until it has all been written. Say how much
is left on the shutdown and restart screens, so you can wait for it.

BUG: 454367
---
 desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml | 15 +++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 15 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml
index 04349c4ebe..0d692cc783 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml
@@ -123,6 +123,21 @@ Item {
             visible: otherSessionsModel.count > 0 && (sdtype !== ShutdownType.ShutdownTypeNone || controls.showAllOptions)
         }
 
+        PlasmaComponents.Label {
+            font.pointSize: Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize + 1
+            Layout.maximumWidth: Math.max(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 16, logoutButtonsRow.implicitWidth)
+            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
+            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
+            font.italic: true
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "%1 is an amount of data, like 300 MiB",
+                         "%1 of data is still being written to disk. If the computer is shut down or restarted, it will wait for this to finish.",
+                         KCoreAddons.Format.formatByteSize(unwrittenDataSize))
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+            visible: unwrittenDataSize > 0 && (sdtype !== ShutdownType.ShutdownTypeNone || controls.showAllOptions)
+        }
+
         PlasmaComponents.Label {
             font.pointSize: Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize + 1
             Layout.maximumWidth: Math.max(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 16, logoutButtonsRow.implicitWidth)
--

media.caption: Pure master: ~400 MiB still waiting to be written, yet the shutdown screen says nothing about it
With the fix, same state: the shutdown screen says how much data is still being written and that shutting down will wait for it
All-options screen: the amount updates live as data is written and the hint disappears once it is done
The log-out-only screen doesn't show the hint, since logging out doesn't wait for disk writes
